description: Turn PRD or spec text into structured requirements (scale, capabilities, compliance, regions, budget) for plan_stack, without planning. recommend_stack does both in one call. Each requirement quotes the sentence it came from. Show them to the user to confirm before planning. Without a model on the server it reads the PRD with keyword rules (mode "rules") and also returns the capability vocabulary and instructions: as an assistant, prefer doing the extraction yourself and use the rules result only as a starting point.
name: extract_requirements

assumptions.description: Usage and pricing assumptions behind the numbers.

caveats.description: Show to the user word for word.

data.description: The tool result. Its shape depends on the tool.

disclosures.description: Always includes the neutrality note: no vendor pays for a place in the answer. Link its url when you mention how Kong Reviews is paid.

title: Extract requirements from a PRD
